Issyk kurgan: 4,000+ gold ornaments indicating elite Scythian-Saka status (established but gender classification contested)

historiography_key_debate.question: Does kurgan hypothesis (Gimbutas 1956) or steppe migration model (ancient DNA 2015+) better explain Proto-Indo-European origins?
timeline: 1956-2000: Gimbutas kurgan hypothesis dominant (archaeology + linguistics unified)
2015+: Ancient DNA models emerged (Haak et al., Mathierson et al.) — genetic evidence challenges single kurgan-culture model
Current (2026): Multiple-wave steppe herder migration models now consensus in genetics; kurgan hypothesis remains influential but secondary
